The Field Kettle is a kettle for a portable stove.
The kettle holds 1.2 litres.
1.2 litres is enough for two mugs of tea and a pot of porridge.
The kettle weighs 310 grams empty.
The body is made of hard-anodised aluminium.
The body is 0.8 mm thick.
The kettle has a rolled lip.
The rolled lip lets the kettle pour without dribbling down the side.
The lid sits in a groove.
The lid stays in place when the kettle is tipped to pour.
The handle folds flat against the body.
The handle locks open with a steel pin.
The handle is wrapped in silicone to the knuckle.
The silicone wrap allows the kettle to be lifted off a gas burner without a glove.
The spout has a hinged cap.
The spout cap whistles at a rolling boil.
With the cap removed, the kettle pours faster.
Pouring with the cap removed is useful for filling a bottle.
On a 2,000-watt canister stove at sea level, 1 litre of water at 15 degrees boils in four minutes and ten seconds.
At 3,000 metres, the makers measured a boil time of five and a half minutes.
The base of the kettle is ribbed.
The ribbed base spreads the heat.
The ribbed base keeps the kettle from rocking on a small burner head.
The kettle does not work on an induction hob.
The kettle nests inside the 1.8 litre pot from the same range.
A 230 gram gas canister fits inside the kettle with the lid on.
A mesh bag is included with the kettle.
The mesh bag is not a dry bag.
The mesh bag will not keep soot off a sleeping bag.
The kettle should be packed in the mesh bag, and the bag in an outside pocket.
The kettle should be washed by hand.
A steel scourer will scratch the anodised finish.
A dishwasher will dull the anodised finish.
The kettle should not be boiled dry.
The handle wrap is rated to 230 degrees.
The aluminium will warp above 230 degrees.
The kettle has a two-year guarantee against faults in materials and manufacture.
Dents from drops and rocks are not covered as faults under the guarantee.
The lid is sold separately for two pounds, post paid.
The handle pin is sold separately for two pounds, post paid.
The kettle comes in 1.2 litre, 1.8 litre and 2.5 litre sizes.
The kettle comes in grey and green.
The kettle is made in Portugal.
